name: Ablative
effect: Spend one Ablative charge to reduce an incoming hit by one additional severity tier, even if no normal Armor Slots remain. Charges return only through professional repair.

name: Assault
effect: Gain +1 on attack rolls made with weapons that have Automatic.

name: Breaching Shield
trigger: The wearer is targeted from the front
effect: Once per round, impose Disadvantage on one attack originating from the wearer’s front arc.

name: Cloaking
effect: Mark 1 Stress to become invisible until the end of your next turn, or until you attack or are hit.

name: Comms
effect: Integrated encrypted communications function to 10 km under normal conditions, or farther through a relay.

name: Environmental
effect: While sealed and powered, the armor protects against vacuum, toxic atmospheres, and extreme temperatures. Breathable-air duration is listed by the item; if none is listed, use 24 hours.

name: Flexible
effect: Gain +1 Evasion while wearing this armor.

name: Fortified
effect: When you mark an Armor Slot, reduce the hit by two severity tiers instead of one.

name: Hardened
effect: Take half damage, rounded down, from the listed damage type before comparing the damage to thresholds. Hardened (All) applies to every damage type.

name: Hazard-Sealed
effect: While sealed, the wearer is immune to contact- or inhalation-based poisons, diseases, and radiation exposure.

name: Heavy
effect: Suffer -1 Evasion while wearing this armor.

name: ID Display
effect: The armor carries configurable, authenticated identification panels. Ordinary credential checks by a recognized authority succeed automatically unless the credentials are forged, revoked, or challenged by superior access.

name: Intimidating
effect: Gain +1 on Presence Rolls to threaten, coerce, or frighten while the armor is visibly worn.

name: Jury-rigged
effect: This armor may be repaired without a workshop. Whenever you mark an Armor Slot, roll d6; on 1, the Keeper introduces a malfunction until repaired.

name: Life Support
effect: A self-contained atmosphere and thermal system protects the wearer in vacuum or hostile air for up to 24 hours on a full charge.

name: Low-Profile
effect: Gain +1 on Finesse Rolls to avoid visual detection while wearing this armor.

name: Massive
effect: Suffer -2 Evasion. Whenever you mark an Armor Slot, roll d6; on 5–6 reduce the hit by one additional severity tier.

name: Modular
effect: Attach up to 3 Burden of equipment to the armor’s external hardpoints. Attached equipment remains accessible and does not occupy the wearer’s hands, but still counts toward total Burden.

name: Pocketed
effect: Carry two additional small items without increasing Burden.

name: Powered
effect: Integrated servos negate the Evasion penalty from Heavy or Very Heavy. If power is lost, the wearer suffers -3 on Agility Rolls until exiting or restoring power.

name: Resilient
trigger: Before marking the last Armor Slot
effect: Before marking your final available Armor Slot, roll d6. On 6, ignore the hit and do not mark the slot.

name: Self-Repair
effect: During any Short or Long Rest, automatically restore one marked Armor Slot in addition to other repairs.

name: Servo-Assisted
effect: Gain +1 on Strength Rolls involving physical exertion and for carrying capacity. Reduce the armor’s effective Burden by 1.

name: Silent
effect: Gain +2 on Finesse Rolls to avoid detection by sound while wearing this armor.

name: Social
effect: The armor appears to be appropriate formal or everyday clothing. It passes visual inspection as unarmored, though a pat-down or scanner can reveal it.

name: Tactical
effect: Gain +1 on Instinct Rolls for perception and Spotlight contests.

name: Thermoptic Camouflage
effect: While stationary or moving at half speed, the wearer is effectively invisible to visual detection. At full speed or after a violent action, visual-detection Rolls against the wearer have Disadvantage instead. The system runs for 1 hour, then requires 10 minutes to recharge.

name: Thruster
effect: Move normally in zero gravity and gain Advantage on Finesse (Pilot/Navigate) or Agility Rolls for zero-gravity maneuvering.

name: Thruster Pack
effect: Provides powered movement in zero gravity for up to 4 hours of maneuvering and limited atmospheric hover for up to 1 minute at a time, with 30 minutes of total continuous thrust.

name: Very Heavy
effect: Suffer -2 Evasion and -1 on all Agility Rolls. Powered servos are required to move normally and do not remove these penalties.

name: Weather-Proof
effect: Ignore ordinary and severe planetary weather hazards, including acid rain, sandstorms, and extreme heat or cold. This does not protect against vacuum.

name: Accurate
trigger: When making an attack at Far or Very Far range
effect: Gain +1 on attack rolls made at Far or Very Far range.

name: Adaptive
effect: Once per scene, change this weapon’s damage type to Physical, Energy, Void, or Neural until changed again.
interactions: Changing damage type changes its standard Penetration but does not add tags such as Thermal or Poison.

name: Anchoring
effect: If the hit deals damage or applies a non-damage payload, the target cannot take a Move action on its next turn unless it passes the resistance roll.

name: Anti-Psionic
effect: Deal +1d6 damage against psionic entities and creatures currently using Veil powers. While the weapon is drawn, psychic abilities targeting the wielder have Disadvantage.

name: Arc
effect: The attack arcs to a second target within Very Close of the first. The second target takes half the rolled damage, rounded down.
interactions: The secondary target is not attacked separately; immunities and damage reduction apply normally.

name: Arcing Shot
effect: Ignore cover when there is a clear vertical or indirect trajectory to the target.

name: Area

parameters.shape: Defined by the item or its other features.

effect: The effect applies to every creature in its listed area, including allies, rather than to a single target.

name: Armor Piercing
effect: Reduce the target’s maximum Armor Slots by the listed rating until its next Long Rest. Multiple applications stack.
interactions: This is temporary maximum-slot reduction, not direct damage and not the same as Shredding.

name: Automatic
effect: After a successful attack, mark 1 Stress to apply the same attack result to a second valid target within range and Very Close of the primary target. Roll damage separately.

name: Biometric
effect: The weapon functions only for registered users. Bypassing or rewriting the lock requires a Knowledge (Tech) Roll, DC 15.

name: Blast
effect: The primary target takes normal damage. Every other creature in the listed radius takes the same damage; allies are affected. A creature behind Total Cover from the impact is unaffected.

name: Bleeding
trigger: When the attack causes HP loss
effect: At the end of each of its turns, the target marks 1 HP directly until a creature spends an Action and succeeds on a Knowledge (Medicine) Roll, DC 10, or combat ends.
interactions: Bleeding ignores thresholds and Armor Slots. Creatures without circulatory systems may be immune.

name: Brittle
trigger: When the attack causes HP loss
effect: A target that loses HP becomes Vulnerable to the next instance of Physical damage it takes; that hit deals +1d6 damage, then Brittle ends.

name: Brutal
effect: Reroll every damage die that shows 1 once and keep the new result.

name: Burst Fire
effect: Whenever a damage die rolls its maximum value, roll one additional die of the same size and add it. Additional dice do not explode again.

name: Charge-Up
effect: Spend an Action charging the weapon. It can be fired on a later turn; the charge is lost if the wielder takes damage, is forcibly moved, or performs another Action before firing.

name: Cleave
effect: After a successful Melee hit, immediately make one additional attack against a different target within this weapon’s reach.

name: Collapsible
effect: While collapsed, the weapon is Concealable and cannot attack. Deploying or collapsing it is part of a weapon swap when the fiction permits; otherwise it is a Maneuver.

name: Concealable
effect: While concealed on the body, this weapon does not count toward Burden. A routine search finds it only on a successful Instinct Roll, DC 15.

name: Cone
effect: Roll once and apply the attack to every creature in a Very Close, approximately 60-degree cone. Allies in the cone are affected.

name: Continuous
effect: The target marks 1 Stress at the start of its next turn.

name: Curse
effect: Whenever the weapon is used, the Keeper gains 1 Fear. On a Fear-dominant roll involving the weapon, the Keeper may also manifest the item’s stated curse.
interactions: Each cursed artifact must describe the fiction of its curse; this property supplies the common mechanical trigger.

name: Cutting
effect: Armor Slots cannot be spent to reduce this instance of damage.

name: Defensive
effect: Gain the listed Evasion bonus against Melee attacks while wielding this weapon.

name: Deployable Cover
effect: Deploy a one-way energy wall approximately 5 m × 3 m. It grants Full Cover from one side and has 10 HP and 6 Armor Slots. It lasts for the scene or until destroyed.

name: Devastating
effect: When damage equals or exceeds the target’s Severe Threshold, the hit marks 1 additional HP.

name: Disintegrating
trigger: When a damage die rolls its maximum
effect: When any damage die rolls its maximum value, the target loses one carried item or one maximum Armor Slot until repaired, Keeper’s choice. A target reduced to 0 HP leaves no recoverable body unless protected by Precursor-grade material.

name: Disorienting
effect: The affected creature is Dazed until the end of its next turn.

name: Dispersal Wave
effect: The effect fills a 5 m cone. Each creature in the cone makes a Presence Reaction Roll, DC 15; on a failure it suffers the weapon’s listed effect.

name: Disruptor
effect: Deal double damage to Shields and Synthetic targets, and half damage, rounded down, to organic HP.

name: EMP
effect: Electronic devices within Very Close of the target, including augmentations, are disabled until the end of their operator’s next turn unless their operator passes a Knowledge (Tech) Reaction Roll against the weapon’s Feature DC. Allies are affected.

name: Energy
effect: This is an Energy weapon. Energy damage treats the target’s Major and Severe Thresholds as 2 lower. The damage line remains the authoritative damage type.
notes: Descriptor/tag entry. It carries no additional value when the damage line already says Energy.

name: Energy Surge
effect: Deal +1d6 Energy damage and the target marks 1 Stress.

name: Entangling
effect: The target becomes Restrained. It or an adjacent creature may spend an Action and pass a Strength Roll against the item’s Feature DC to end the condition.

name: Entrapping
effect: The target becomes Incapacitated. Another creature must spend an Action and pass a Strength or Knowledge (Tech) Roll against the item’s Feature DC to free it.

name: Existence
effect: This Precursor effect alters the target’s state, identity, location, or continuity instead of dealing ordinary damage. The item’s own text and the Keeper define the exact alteration.
notes: Story-gated. Never treat this as a generic permission to erase a player character without consent and established stakes.

name: Explosive
effect: Every creature within Very Close of the impact point makes an Agility Reaction Roll against the item’s Feature DC. On a failure, it takes 1d6 Physical damage; on a success, half damage. Total Cover blocks the blast.

name: Finesse
effect: You may use Finesse instead of the weapon’s listed attack Trait.

name: Fragile
effect: Whenever this weapon would degrade one step, it degrades two steps instead.

name: Garrote
effect: This weapon may attack only a Surprised or unaware target unless used as part of a grapple. Against a Surprised target, a hit is automatically a Critical Hit.

name: Guided
effect: You may attack a target you are aware of within range without direct line of sight. Guided attacks ignore cover except a completely sealed barrier or other Total Cover that leaves no viable path.

name: Heavy
effect: A wielder with Strength 0 or lower has Disadvantage on attacks with this weapon. Its Burden still applies normally.

name: High-Recoil
effect: After each attack with this weapon, a wielder with Strength 0 or lower marks 1 Stress.

name: Ignite
trigger: When the attack causes HP loss
effect: A target that loses HP is On Fire. At the start of its turn it must mark 1 Stress or take 1d4 Energy damage. It or an adjacent creature may spend an Action to extinguish the fire.

name: Intimidating
effect: Gain +1 on Presence Rolls to threaten, coerce, or frighten while the weapon is visibly wielded.

name: Knockdown
effect: The target must pass an Agility or Strength Reaction Roll, its choice, against the weapon’s Feature DC or become Prone.

name: Lightweight
effect: This weapon does not count toward Burden. A one-handed Lightweight weapon may be used comfortably in the off hand, but does not grant an extra attack.

name: Loud
effect: Using this weapon alerts everyone in the Zone, and potentially farther at Keeper discretion. Its sound cannot be removed by a modification.

name: Massive
effect: The wielder suffers -1 Evasion. On a hit, roll one additional normal damage die and discard the lowest normal damage die before totaling damage.

name: Melting
trigger: When the attack causes HP loss
effect: A target that loses HP takes 1d6 damage of the weapon’s damage type at the start of each of its next two turns. An appropriate cooling, neutralizing, or decontamination Action ends the effect early.

name: Messy
effect: This weapon leaves unmistakable residue, damage, or biological evidence. Concealing that a confrontation occurred is normally impossible without extensive cleanup.

name: Mind Link
effect: This Psionic weapon may target a creature the wielder is aware of within range even without line of sight.

name: Mind-Lock
trigger: When the target marks Stress from this weapon
effect: When this weapon causes a target to mark Stress, that target makes a Presence Reaction Roll against the weapon’s Feature DC. On a failure, it may only Move on its next turn.

name: Non-Lethal
effect: By default, this weapon cannot reduce a target below 1 HP. A target held at 1 HP is Incapacitated rather than Dying. The attacker may declare lethal use before rolling, losing this protection for that attack.

name: Overheating
effect: After each attack, roll d6. On 1–2, either mark 1 Stress to force cooling or spend an Action cooling before the weapon can attack again.

name: Paired
effect: When wielding two weapons that both have Paired, add the listed Paired bonus from one of them to the damage of an attack made with either weapon. Only one Paired bonus applies per attack.

name: Phasing
effect: The weapon deals Void damage, ignores cover on ranged attacks, and ignores one Armor Slot on a hit. Its Void damage also applies the normal -4 Threshold Penetration. A Void Ward cancels the Penetration but not the ignored Armor Slot unless it explicitly cancels the whole feature.

name: Poison
trigger: When the attack causes HP loss
effect: When the attack causes HP loss, the target marks 1 Stress. A Poison (Special) item replaces this effect with its own text.

name: Powerful
effect: This weapon’s listed damage die is one size larger than the standard die for its chassis. The damage line already includes this increase.
notes: Construction descriptor; no additional value beyond the printed damage.

name: Probability Shift
effect: After rolling the attack, you may reroll both Duality Dice. You must use the new result.

name: Psionic
effect: Resolve attacks with this weapon against the target’s Presence rather than Evasion. Wards and effects that block Veil contact block the attack.

name: Quick
effect: After attacking, mark 1 Stress to immediately make a second attack against the same target.

name: Range
effect: This weapon may make attacks at the listed range band despite otherwise being a Melee weapon.

name: Reach
effect: This Melee weapon may attack a target at the listed distance, normally Very Close, without entering Melee range.

name: Reality Shift
effect: After a hit, change that hit’s damage type to Physical, Energy, Void, or Neural before applying Threshold Penetration.

name: Reliable
effect: Gain +1 on all attack rolls made with this weapon.

name: Reload
effect: After each shot, spend an Action reloading before the weapon can attack again.

name: Salvo Fire
effect: After a successful attack, mark 1 Stress to apply the same attack result to a second target within Close of the primary target. Roll damage separately.

name: Scatter
effect: At Very Close range, gain +1 to the attack roll and +2 damage. At Close range or farther, suffer -1 to the attack roll.

name: Scope
effect: When you spend an Action to Aim, gain +2 on the next attack with this weapon instead of the normal +1, and treat range penalties as one band closer.

name: Set
trigger: An enemy enters the weapon’s reach
effect: When an enemy enters this weapon’s reach during movement, make an immediate attack against it. On a hit, add +1d6 damage.

name: Shield
effect: This item counts as a shield for features that reference shields. Choose a facing while wielding it; gain +2 Evasion against ranged attacks originating from that direction.

name: Shield Piercing
effect: Only half of the target’s available Armor Slots, rounded down, may be spent against this hit.

name: Shredding
effect: When the attack causes HP loss, reduce the target’s maximum Armor Slots by 1 until the armor is repaired during Downtime.

name: Silent
effect: Using this weapon creates no report or muzzle flash and does not automatically break stealth or alert creatures beyond the immediate victim.

name: Singularity
effect: Choose a point at Far range. Creatures within Close of it make a Strength Reaction Roll against the item’s Feature DC; on a failure they are pulled toward the point and Restrained until the end of their next turn.

name: Smart Scope
effect: Gain +2 on attack rolls at Far or Very Far range.

name: Spray
effect: Instead of one target, roll once and apply the attack to every creature in a Very Close, approximately 60-degree cone. Allies in the cone are affected.

name: Stable
effect: This weapon ignores Overheating and other sustained-use malfunctions unless a rule explicitly overrides Stable.

name: Stagger
effect: A target damaged by this weapon has Disadvantage on its next action.

name: Stun
effect: Before rolling damage, choose to deal Stress instead of HP damage. Use the same damage dice and apply Stress directly rather than comparing to damage thresholds.

name: Stunning
effect: A damaged target makes a Strength Reaction Roll against the item’s Feature DC. On a failure it is Stunned until the end of its next turn.

name: Stunning on crit
effect: On a Critical Hit, the target is Stunned until the end of its next turn.

name: Sundering
effect: Destroy the target’s held shield, or reduce its maximum Armor Slots by 2 until professionally repaired.

name: Suppressive
effect: Mark 1 Stress. Every creature within Close of the target has Disadvantage on attacks until the end of its next turn.

name: Sustained Fire
effect: On a later turn, if you have not moved, the target remains in range, and it lacks Total Cover, spend your Action to deal the original rolled damage again without a new attack roll. Repeat under the same conditions.
interactions: The lock ends if the wielder moves, takes another Action, loses line of effect, or the target leaves range.

name: System Shock
effect: Against Synthetics and machines, deal normal damage. Against organic targets, deal only 1d4 Stress. If any damage die rolls its maximum, one target electronic device malfunctions until repaired or reset.

name: Taser Charge
effect: The target makes a Strength Reaction Roll against the item’s Feature DC. On a failure it is Stunned until the end of its next turn.

name: Temporal
effect: Roll d6 after a hit: 1–2, deal double damage; 3–4, deal normal damage; 5–6, deal no damage to the target and instead a random enemy within range takes damage equal to one previous attack you made this combat. If none exists, deal normal damage.

name: Thermal
effect: The target makes a Strength Reaction Roll against the weapon’s Feature DC. On a failure it catches fire and takes 1d4 Energy damage at the start of each turn until a creature spends an Action extinguishing it.

name: Thrown
effect: The weapon may be thrown to make an attack at the listed range band. Unless it has Returning, it must be recovered before it can be used again.

name: Two-Handed
effect: The weapon requires both hands to wield and cannot be used while holding another item.

name: Unraveling
effect: When any damage die rolls its maximum, the target loses access to one class or ancestry feature, Keeper’s choice, until the end of the scene.

name: Unstable
effect: When the Fear Die shows 1–5 on an attack with this weapon, the wielder marks 1 Stress and the weapon degrades one step.

name: Unwieldy
effect: Suffer -2 on attack rolls unless you did not move this turn or spent your previous turn setting up without attacking with this weapon.

name: Vibration
effect: Armor Slots cannot be spent to reduce this instance of damage.

name: Waveform
effect: The attack affects every creature in a 5 m cone. Roll once and compare the result to each target.
